purpose: One-shot confirmatory test of cross-policy information propagation on 72 newly generated unseen target tasks following exploratory development on the existing 86-task panel.

confirmatory_panel.note_on_opsd: All 20 usable ENTSO-E OPSD markets (6 source + 14 target) were already exhausted in exploratory_86; no synthetic OPSD tasks are fabricated.

fixed_experimental_controls.initial_observations: Identical N0=8 cold-DCT designs (2 replications each) and scarce 2-design subset {x_sq, x_cold_1} across all compared models
fixed_experimental_controls.representation_and_basis: Identical public rollout psi(x) and identical source-learned active spectral basis tilde_phi(psi(x))
fixed_experimental_controls.noise_model: Identical target-only within-policy HVD variance fit (use_source_hvd_prior=False)
fixed_experimental_controls.probe_and_heldout_selection: 4 deterministic probe policies selected purely by public active-basis cosine leverage (zero ground-truth or Sigma_0 peeking) and 32 disjoint held-out DCT policies audited on 400 independent replications

family_A_zero_mean_kernel_propagation_re.description: Post-probe held-out demeaned shape NRMSE differences (comparator minus structured, >0 favors structured) across four models sharing zero source mean mu_{0,act}=0 and identical active-subspace trace tr(Sigma_act)

family_B_online_sure_post_probe_accuracy.description: Post-probe held-out demeaned shape NRMSE differences across online adaptive surrogates

secondary_endpoints: Single-step before-to-after error reductions delta_nrmse (8->9 and 2->3) with positive/negative/zero task counts
Single-step Gaussian predictive log-score changes delta_logscore
Held-out Spearman rank correlation changes delta_spearman
stopping_rule: Execute confirm_fresh_72 exactly once; report all positive, null, and negative outcomes without sample expansion.
